_about: Settings for /downloads (build.mjs buildDownloads(), src/downloads/). Version data comes from Modrinth: src/data/downloads.json (downloads-tools/fetch-downloads.mjs), refreshed live in the browser.
_betas: Shown as locked Beta tiles in the version list, for patrons on the named Patreon tier and up. A version drops out of this list on its own once Modrinth has it.
_optifine: Versions that need OptiFine: linked in the download box and the install steps.

launchers.name: Modrinth App
launchers.blurb: Modrinth's own launcher. Installs the modpack in one click.
steps: Install and open the Modrinth App.
Open the {packTitle} page and click Install, or search for Conquest Reforged in the app.
Before you play, set the memory to about {memory} GB in the instance's Java settings.

launchers.name: Prism Launcher
launchers.blurb: Free, open source, and keeps each version in its own instance.
steps: Install and open Prism Launcher.
Click Add Instance, open the Modrinth tab, search for Conquest Reforged and install the {loaderName} modpack. Or choose Import and pick the .mrpack file from the download box.
Go to Settings → Java and set the maximum memory to about {memory} GB.

launchers.name: ATLauncher
steps: Install and open ATLauncher.
Go to Packs, open the Modrinth tab, search for Conquest Reforged and install the {loaderName} modpack.
Go to Settings → Java and set the maximum memory to about {memory} GB.

modSteps: Put the Conquest Reforged .jar and the required mods listed in the download box into your mods folder.

modSteps.text: Put {optifineName} in the mods folder too. Conquest Reforged needs it on this Minecraft version.
Add Continuity to the mods folder as well: on Fabric, the resource pack needs it for connected textures.

Put the Conquest Reforged Resource Pack for {mc} (in the download box) in your resourcepacks folder and turn it on under Options → Resource Packs. Without it you miss the connected textures, the sky and the biome colors.

modSteps: Give Minecraft about {memory} GB of memory.

converters.note: Made years ago for much older versions of Minecraft and no longer updated. From 1.15 on you don't need them: open your world in each newer version in turn (1.15 → 1.16 → 1.17 → …).
tips: Convert a copy, never your only save.
If a conversion goes wrong, copy your builds with WorldEdit schematics or structure blocks into a fresh world that only uses Conquest Reforged, and convert that.
Map makers: please convert and re-publish your map yourselves rather than having every player convert it.
